metadata.description: seymurglv's own tools: agent plugins, the banui library and machine setup.

plugins.name: banui
plugins.description: The banui design language: every control built from five signs, with a lamp color map, the built library, a ready settings screen and control recipes.

plugins.name: cache-lamp
plugins.description: A lamp above the prompt box for the state of the session's prompt cache, and a quiet ping that keeps a big cache warm while you are away.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Art direction for websites, taken straight from Leonxlnx's taste-skill repository: real photographs and icons, one section per screen, and a checker and finish gate that test the page in headless Chrome.

plugins.name: waypoints
plugins.description: Up to three likely next prompts as quiet rows above the prompt box after each turn.
